text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Boss?! 1st place! That's 
my true strength for ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Sis?! 1st place! That's 
my true strength for ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Wanna go have a blast and 
celebrate, or what?
choice_data_list: Let's celebrate with all we've got!
Just don't get too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the spirit! Since it's settled, 
how 'bout we feast on some sea bream!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Celebrate with lucky charms, eat well to 
build up your strength, and you'll 
definitely win the next fight, too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, guess this ain't enough to satisfy 
you, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, guess this ain't enough to satisfy 
you, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun, I'm in! Time for special 
training for the next match!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure, when we bloom big and 
bright, you throw us a ridiculously flashy 
celebration party!
